episodes.166458: Large clusters of thunderstorms developed and moved across Central Florida, and as these storms moved offshore they produced numerous strong wind gusts along the coast from Brevard County to Martin County.
episodes.166459: Numerous strong thunderstorms developed across east-central Florida. Several storms becoming severe as they moved through Osceola, Brevard, and Indian River Counties, where hail and damaging winds were observed.
episodes.167280: Two people were injured after being struck by lightning at an outdoor event.
episodes.167290: A shortwave moving across the area interacting with a quasi-stationary frontal boundary over the state produced gusty storms over the coastal waters.
episodes.167355: Convection moved inland from the Gulf of Mexico through midday ahead of a deepening upper level trough. Elevated thunderstorms along and north of a lifting warm front produced hail across NE FL with strong westerly flow from 500-300 mb of 65-75 kts. There were widespread reports of pea to penny size hail across NE FL with storms (0.25 to 0.75 inches in diameter).
episodes.167356: Scattered thunderstorms ahead of an approaching frontal boundary brought gusty winds and a waterspout to the coastal waters.
episodes.167663: Convection moved inland from the Gulf of Mexico through midday ahead of a deepening upper level trough. Elevated thunderstorms along and north of a lifting warm front produced hail across NE FL with strong westerly flow from 500-300 mb of 65-75 kts.
episodes.168291: Heavy rain in March brought flooding to several rivers in Arkansas...the White, Black, and the Ouachita rivers.
episodes.168597: A stalled front across Central Florida once again provided support for strong showers and thunderstorms over eastern sections of South Florida. Strong wind gusts were the primary impacts.
